source.title: 李志起图册_360百科
source.description:
Portrait of Li Zhiqi

Li Zhiqi appears in a formal studio portrait dressed in a dark pinstripe suit, white dress shirt, and a blue-and-purple striped tie. He stands with his arms crossed, exuding confidence and professionalism against a plain black background.

This photograph is featured in the “李志起图册” gallery on a Chinese online encyclopedia, showcasing images of Li Zhiqi’s involvement in public welfare activities prior to his passing. The clean composition and focused lighting emphasize his poised demeanor and business attire.
